bob_owns_instance_flag.meaning: Bob owns the agent instance and intends to register it to the legitimate service

alice_knows_instance_address_flag.meaning: Alice knows Bob's instance address before it is officially registered

fake_service_bond_wei.meaning: bond requirement of Alice's fake service, reported as minimal (e.g., 1 wei)
fake_service_bond_wei.checkpoint: when Alice creates the fake service

instance_registered_elsewhere_flag.meaning: Bob's agent instance is not yet registered to another service at the time Alice acts

caller_is_designated_operator.meaning: the caller of ServiceManager::registerAgents is the designated operator of the instance being registered

registration_authorized.meaning: the registration of the instance is performed by an authorized entity (its designated operator)

bob_registration_transaction_fails_flag.meaning: Bob's attempt to register the same instance to the legitimate service fails because the instance is already registered elsewhere
bob_registration_transaction_fails_flag.checkpoint: after Alice's registration, when Bob attempts registration

claims.scope: When Bob attempts to register the same instance to the legitimate service, the transaction fails due to the instance already being registered elsewhere.

preconditions.text: Bob owns an agent instance and intends to register it to a legitimate service.; Alice knows Bob's instance address before it is officially registered.; Alice creates a fake service with minimal bond requirements (e.g., 1 wei).; Bob's agent instance is not yet registered to another service at the time Alice acts.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: ServiceManager::registerAgents should verify that the caller is the designated operator of each instance being registered, so that only authorized entities can register a given instance.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: When Bob attempts to register the same instance to the legitimate service, the transaction fails due to the instance already being registered elsewhere.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The registration action is performed through ServiceManager::registerAgents.
The designated operator of an instance is observable via an operator function or equivalent.

limitations: The authorization guard is expressed with derived booleans because the report does not give a concrete operator-address comparison.
The impact is encoded as a Boolean failure outcome; the report does not provide a numeric or address-level observable for the failure.
